learning_outcomes.text: Explain the types, sources, formation mechanisms, and atmospheric behavior of air pollutants.
Interpret the effects of air pollution on human health, ecosystems, materials, and climate, along with relevant legislation and standards.
Determine emission rates and pollutant concentrations using mass balances and basic calculation methods.
Analyze factors affecting the atmospheric dispersion of air pollutants and apply simple dispersion models.
Explain the operating principles, design parameters, and selection criteria of control technologies for particulate and gaseous pollutants.
Select, size, and evaluate the performance of an appropriate control technology/system for a given source in terms of efficiency, cost, and environmental impacts.

syllabus_topics: Causes and effects of air pollution
Sources of air pollution and pollutants
Relationships between air pollution and meteorology
Relationships between air pollution and meteorology
bibliography: Air Pollution Control Engineering, McGraw-Hills, Inc., Noel de Nevers, New York 1995.
